args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks after deploy (unhealthy, error rate ~18% in us-east, us-west, eu-west). The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback is complete in every region. Next steps: watch post-rollback health and find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions, it's passing health checks again, and the SEV2 incident is open.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks with about an 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions, and the error rate has dropped to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api), which paged on-call. It explains what failed, what I rolled back, and the next steps: keep an eye on health and find out why v2.3.1 failed before deploying it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
